    Description

    The Tiroler Weinstube, located 20 km from the Mieminger Plateau Golf Park, offers accommodations with hardwood floors, a garden, a terrace, and a restaurant. The Tiroler Weinstube provides both Wi-Fi and private parking at no extra charge. Some units also feature a kitchen equipped with a refrigerator, a dishwasher, and an oven. A casino is available on-site, and guests can enjoy skiing and biking in the immediate vicinity of the Tiroler Weinstube. The Golden Roof is 23 km from the Tiroler Weinstube, while Innsbruck Central Station is 24 km away. The nearest airport is Innsbruck Airport, 17 km from the Tiroler Weinstube.
